note: Rabobank's package comparison: Rabo Standaard, a package for everyday banking, costs 3.60 euros a month; Rabo Free, its free current account for ages 18 to 28, stands for the younger holder, so the game waives the fee under 28. Read again 2026-10-30 (columns Rabo Free, Rabo Standaard, Rabo Comfort): with Rabo Standaard, withdrawing at Geldmaat (the Dutch banks' shared machines, so own and other at home) costs nothing; in another currency at a machine that isn't Geldmaat 3.50 EUR a time; in euros at one abroad 0.83 EUR (not written: the form holds one figure abroad). An overdraft (rood staan) is offered by agreement; its rate isn't on this page. Not stated: interest, transfers, a returned payment, the card's share on another currency, what opening asks.
